acceptance: Red test first: a reviewer output whose field says PASS and whose body lists one HIGH gives verdict FAIL.
A disagreement emits one signal that names the run id.
evolve commit-gate refuses an attestation whose derived verdict is FAIL.
The doc of evolve agent run states the rule in STE.
fix: Derive the envelope verdict from the declared report artifact (a schema-checked findings file with severity counts), not from a separate free field. When the field and the body disagree, the envelope verdict is FAIL and the run emits a signal. The commit gate reads the derived verdict.
notes: Console route: agent run and the commit gate are the review path of the console itself.
source: console, 2026-10-27, docs-review run on PR #1197 and the cycle-2035 salvage
summary: Reviews through evolve agent run return an envelope whose verdict field can say PASS while the report body says FAIL. This occurred at least twice: the cycle-2035 salvage reviews and the docs-review round 1 of PR #1197 on 2026-10-27 (run agent-docs-review-20261027T060904Z-90c9, body FAIL with 1 HIGH). A gate or a reader that trusts the field passes a failed review.
title: The verdict of evolve agent run comes from the report body, so a FAIL report cannot carry a PASS verdict
